broader_bounded_claim_text: The reviewed corpus supports a bounded account of mechanisms and directional pressures affecting safety compensation more strongly than it supports any global wage-gap, prevalence, or causal-effect estimate.
canonical_claim_text_before: The corpus supports the direction and operation of a safety wage-pressure story more strongly than it supports a clean global wage-gap or causal-effect estimate.
evidence_that_would_falsify: Reviewed same-unit evidence consistently opposite to: The reviewed corpus supports a bounded account of mechanisms and directional pressures affecting safety compensation more strongly than it supports any global wage-gap, prevalence, or causal-effect estimate.
evidence_that_would_strengthen: Repeated same-city, same-period, same-cycle safety/non-safety contracts with harmonized pay basis, comparable roles, total-compensation components, and a credible panel or shock-based identification design.
final_claim_class_reason: Direct strict evidence supports this bounded evidence-boundary proposition, and broader evidence does not contradict it.
final_claim_text: The reviewed corpus supports a bounded account of mechanisms and directional pressures affecting safety compensation more strongly than it supports any global wage-gap, prevalence, or causal-effect estimate.
geographic_scope: reviewed multi-state municipalities only; not nationally representative
language_boundary: local/mechanism/sample-specific; no national wage gap, prevalence, or causal effect
prohibited_claim_text: The corpus estimates a national safety wage gap or causal effect.
report_body_wording: The reviewed corpus supports a bounded account of mechanisms and directional pressures affecting safety compensation more strongly than it supports any global wage-gap, prevalence, or causal-effect estimate.
side_scope: explicit source-supported sides only; unresolved-side records excluded from comparative support
source_quality_summary: canonical documentary examples plus cross-examined strict/bounded administrative summaries; exact source coordinates remain in linked evidence packets
